action.objective: Verify d6e7, the reserved top candidate: capture the knight on e7 to relieve pressure, using the full single-candidate allowance.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggested d6e7 (exact 92) but it is unverified. The bishop on d6 is attacked by Rb6, so Bxe7 removes the target and trades into a better structure. Reserved verification budget is 2000 nodes at max depth 4.
